topic: Create a draft from existing slides

steps.when: A reporting-date or source-version conflict needs inspection
steps.content: Show related versions and date evidence; keep uncertainty visible before selection.
Show ordered candidates with source deck, original slide number, reportDate or uncertainty, dateReason, source URL and selection reason.

steps.required: Explicit confirmation of the selected slide IDs and order.

steps.when: User supplies or requests a PowerPoint template
steps.topic: Upload and apply a PowerPoint template
steps.output: templateId, fileName and warnings; omit template_id when not requested

input.title: user title
input.template_id: optional exact templateId returned by the upload topic; omit when absent

steps.onPending: Tell user still processing; check again on request.

steps.content: Only when completed, return webUrl plus relevant warnings and source map.

notes: Direct custom connector is the default; Agent flow wrapper is optional.
No automatic push notification is implemented.
Do not interpret an installation link as permission to use an agent or its source library.

CreateDraft.inputBinding: Use confirmed topic variables, not AI-filled confirmation.

UploadTemplate.inputBinding: Bind file_name and original binary content_base64 through a File-input topic/flow. Never fill these with AI.

ApplyTemplate.inputBinding: Bind owned completed job_id and uploaded template_id after an explicit user request. Do not add redundant confirmation when intent and target are clear.

steps.note: Guard against empty System.Activity.Attachments. If multiple files arrive, establish which is the template.

steps.identity: Same end-user requester as CreateDraft and ApplyTemplate

steps.onCompleted: Return new webUrl and relevant warnings; retain original draft link.

templateWorkflow.validation: PPTX/POTX binary attachment support must be tested in the selected agent harness and actual published channel; backend support does not imply channel support.

v2StorylineWorkflow.status: design blueprint only: must be configured manually in an approved Copilot Studio tenant
v2StorylineWorkflow.trigger: User asks for a multi-section presentation or for revisions to a saved plan

steps.prompt: Propose 2–8 audience-specific sections with title, query, estimated slides, and goals. Do not invent facts or source IDs.

steps.content: Present section structure, exact source slide IDs, file, page, report period, gap flags, and plan revision. Explain any uncertainties.

steps.when: User requests a new section, focus, order, dates or template

inputs.sections: full revised section list with exact source slide IDs

steps.required: User explicitly approves the precise current planId, revision, source order and template. No call on refusal.

steps.trigger: only after explicit confirmation of latest plan

steps.onPending: Inform user of queued/running state; check on request.
steps.onCompleted: Return authenticated SharePoint webUrl with warnings and sourceMap; no invented link.

CreateDraftFromPlan.inputBinding: Bound from confirmed topic variables only

RevisePresentationPlan.inputBinding: Bound to current plan revision; never silently overwrite concurrent edits

boundaries: No AI-generated factual slides in V2.
Existing template apply is limited; no claim of automatic full redesign.
There is no dedicated semantic vector service; LLM generates search queries.
Plan data stores approved slide references, not newly invented facts.
No tenant publication or connector import is performed by this file.
